n77aef5ed14.headline: Deloitte announces record global revenue of $36.8bn
n77aef5ed14.summary: Deloitte reported aggregate network revenue of $36.8 billion for the fiscal year ended May 31, 2016, representing 9.5% growth in local currency terms.
n77aef5ed14.why: Deloitte is one of the world's largest professional services firms, and its revenue growth reflects trends in consulting, audit, and advisory services globally.

ndccc8972f5.headline: CNB continues interventions against stronger koruna, spent over eight billion in July | Aktuálně.cz
ndccc8972f5.summary: The Czech National Bank intervened in the foreign exchange market, spending 8.29 billion korunas to purchase euros and weaken the koruna in July.
ndccc8972f5.why: Central bank FX interventions affect currency valuation, export competitiveness, and inflation dynamics in the Czech Republic.
